items.title: John Beal interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 18, 2024
items.q: When I realized that I wasn’t going to be playing with Miles I decided well I’ll go to Juilliard

ctx.x: So that’s sort of my question here. Did you, as a young man, think this thing out as if I’m going to make a living in this business by being able to do absolutely anything? Or did the work just present itself and you learned how to do it as it presented?

That’s an embarrassing question you know. When I realized that I wasn’t going to be playing with Miles I decided well I’ll go to Juilliard — at least I’ll be playing the bass, I’ll learn how to play in an orchestra and play the instrument, and so that sort of led me into different areas. And I might add that playing “legitimately,” in quotes — you know, symphonically — you have different skills and it gives you the longevity in the music business. Like when you’re playing in a rhythm section, rhythm sections are…
What was it about John Beal besides your skill as a player that would keep you high on the contractor’s list? Do you have a work ethic you can share with me?
